title: Terminate agreement
purpose: Record that an executed agreement was terminated.
summary: Record that an executed agreement was terminated. Admin and manager only.

tasks.title: Terminate the agreement
steps: Enter [[Terminated on]] and the [[Reason]], then select [[Terminate agreement]].

tasks.title: Cover requests by another agreement
steps: Link a valid agreement on each request that still needs to dispatch.

good_to_know: Nothing can be dispatched under it from the termination date.

items.label: Terminated on
items.description: Required; not before the effective date. Nothing can be dispatched under the agreement from this date.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept in the timeline. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

Only an executed agreement can be terminated; otherwise the form shows Not available. Linked requests keep the link. A termination cannot be undone. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
